## Environment fidelity notes

- **GOTMPDIR** is set in `containerEnv` (`go test` compiles+execs test binaries into $TMPDIR; some sandboxes mount `/tmp` noexec). Create the directory if your tooling doesn't auto-create it: `mkdir -p $GOTMPDIR`.
